title: cobweb
description: A variety of features regarding cobwebs, buttons, delays for minecraft
body:
# Cobweb Utils

A lightweight Fabric PvP utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.11.

## Current Features

### Place Through Players

Allows cobwebs and buttons to be placed on valid blocks behind player hitboxes.

Normally, if a player is standing directly against a wall, their hitbox prevents block placement. Cobweb Utils ignores player hitboxes during placement checks and targets the block behind them while still respecting vanilla placement range.

Supported blocks:

* Cobwebs
* All vanilla button variants


### Misc features:
Walking trough cobwebs unslowed

Mining whilst falling inside a cobweb is unslowed

Switching between items no longer makes you have a coolodwn (sword to web can now be insta placed)

Waterbucket bind: When crouching and right clicking water will be placed automatically

### Vanilla Reach Preserved

Cobweb Utils does not increase placement reach. It only removes the obstruction caused by player hitboxes.

### Lightweight

* Client-side Fabric mod
* Fabric API
* No commands
* Minimal performance impact


## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

## Disclaimer

Cobweb Utils does not bypass server-side placement checks, anti-cheat systems, or other server restrictions.
